subject: truck2077
pitch:
Category: Vehicle.
Subject: futuristic militarized truck from 2077.
Style: low-poly cyberpunk, extremely intricate.

spec.name: Warhound MX-77 Armored Truck
spec.description: A low-poly cyberpunk 2077 militarized 6x6 truck with angular armor plating, neon underglow, a roof-mounted railgun turret and an armored cargo bed with missile racks.
spec.layout: Long 6x6 armored hauler facing +Z. Front: sloped wedge hood with a light bar bumper and a winch plow. Then a forward-set armored cab with a raked slit windscreen and side-mounted sensor pods. Behind the cab: a long cargo bay with angular armor panels, roof hatches and a rear missile rack, and a rear ramp-bumper. Three axles (front at z=2.6, mid at z=-1.4, rear at z=-2.9) with big chunky low-poly wheels with glowing neon hub rings. A dorsal railgun turret sits on a ring over the cargo front. Hard-edged chamfered plates, hazard-yellow trim, cyan and magenta neon strips, glowing red sensor eyes and amber panel lights. All parts built from faceted primitives with painted panel seams, rivets, decals and SVG emblems/warning labels. Everything stands on y=0 via the tyres.

parts.builds: Ladder-frame chassis and underbody: two long steel rails, cross-members, three axle housings with differential pods and leaf-spring/shock assemblies, fuel tanks and exhaust pipes on both sides, side skirts with hazard-yellow chevron paint, mud flaps, skid plates, and glowing neon underglow strips (cyan left, magenta right). Fenders over each wheel are NOT here (see wheels). Panelled iron paint with rivets, grease stains near axles. Includes front bumper block with winch drum and cable, tow hooks, and rear bumper beam with amber tail lights and a licence plate decal 'MX-77'.
parts.attaches: Top face at chassisTop (y=1.2) carries cab, cargo and hood; axle housings centre on frontAxle, midAxle, rearAxle; rear bumper at rearBumper; all geometry on joint body.

parts.builds: Six large faceted low-poly tyres (octagonal-sixteen tread, radius 0.62, width 0.5) with chunky tread blocks around the circumference, steel rims with lug nuts, spoked hub plates and glowing neon cyan hub rings (glow kit), brake discs with red calipers. Angular armored fender arches above each wheel with hazard-yellow edge trim and stacked armor blocks. Each wheel rides its own wheel joint (wheelFL, wheelFR, wheelML, wheelMR, wheelRL, wheelRR) on the axle mounts; fenders ride body. Tyres are bottom-touching y=0.
parts.attaches: Wheel centres at frontAxle, midAxle, rearAxle at x=±1.2; hub axes along X; fenders sit on the chassis rails and reach up to y~1.3.

parts.builds: Armored cab and sloped wedge hood from z=+4.3 back to cabBack. Hood: chamfered wedge with vents, glowing cyan grille slits, a heavy angular plow/bull-bar with a magenta neon bar and quad amber headlight clusters, hood-mounted twin sensor masts. Cab: raked slit windscreen and side windows in dark glass with painted reflections, thick roll-cage frame, angular roof with antenna array, radar dish, roof light bar (red/blue emissive), side mirrors as camera pods with red glowing lenses, door panels with riveted plating, hazard stripes, a big white SVG unit emblem and stencil text on doors, grab handles, exhaust stacks behind the cab, a camo-painted upper roof. Interior hint: seats and dash glow visible through glass (simple boxes, cyan screens).
parts.attaches: Sits on chassisTop at cabFloor / cabBack; hood front aligns with chassis front; back wall at z=0.2 meets cargo front wall at cabBack; all on joint body.

parts.builds: Armored cargo module from cabBack to rearBumper: slab-sided angular container with chamfered edges, layered armor plates, panelled paint with rivets and seam lines, hazard yellow trim bands, stencilled serial numbers and warning SVG labels (biohazard, ammo), side utility lockers with amber lights, roof hatches, cooling vents with glowing magenta slits, tie-down rails, a rear missile rack of eight tubes (four per side) with red warheads, a rear ramp door on joint rampRear (hinged at the bottom, slightly closed rest pose) with a hazard chevron and big warning light, and neon cyan edge strips along the roof line. Roof front has a flat mounting deck for the turret ring at turretRing.
parts.attaches: Sits on chassisTop from z=0.2 back to z=-4.0; front wall meets cab back at cabBack; roof deck top at y~2.5 supports the turret ring at turretRing; ramp on rampRear; body geometry on joint body.

parts.builds: Roof-mounted railgun turret on turretRing: a round base ring with toothed gear teeth (clockwork gears kit as detail), a rotating faceted armored housing on turretYaw with angled plates, camo/hull panelling, sensor eye cluster with glowing red lenses, ammo box and belt, twin smoke grenade launchers, a long railgun on gunPitch: two parallel steel rails with glowing cyan coil rings along the barrel, a muzzle brake with magenta emissive tip, cooling fins, cable runs from housing to barrel, a small antenna and a hazard-yellow stripe and a white skull/crosshair SVG decal on the side shield.
parts.attaches: Base ring centred on turretRing (0,2.55,-0.1) over cargo roof deck; housing rides turretYaw; barrel rides gunPitch whose pivot is at [0,2.95,0.3].

calls.reasoning:
I'm designing the turret gun function with a yaw joint and pitch joint hierarchy, sizing the gun box and barrel length, and planning a base ring structure.

Now I'm detailing the body gear ring with proper teeth count and pitch radius, then building the turret housing as an octagonal cylinder with angled mantlet, side shields, and a hazard stripe decal.

For the gun assembly on the pitch joint, I'm planning twin rails, torus-shaped coil rings with glow, a muzzle brake, fins, and cable sweeps, plus a rear antenna and a glowing sensor eye cluster on the housing's front-left.

Adding ammo box with a curved belt and dual smoke launcher tubes at the back. For colors, I'm using palette tones with panelled/metal paint kits and a camo mottle blend, plus a glow helper for flat-colored parts and a decal-textured plane for a skull/crosshair facing outward, with a shield piece on the left side.

Rather than an octagonal cylinder, I'm switching the housing to a boxy body with chamfered edges from rotated boxes, adding an extruded side shield outline, and placing decal planes outward-facing on one or both sides depending on symmetry needs.

Working out the housing dimensions with a sloped top wedge, mantlet box near the pivot point, and gun rails running along z with small coil rings spaced along their length at matching radius.

Adding the torus muzzle brake collar, a magenta-tipped box at the muzzle, and stacked cooling fin boxes along the housing's rear. I'm also placing an ammo box on one side and planning a brass belt following a curved path between the ammo box and mantlet using small boxes placed along that path.

Next I'm figuring out part placement with explicit bone binding to the turret yaw joint, then adding smoke launcher rod clusters on the rear corners, a sensor eye mast with glowing red spheres on top of the housing, and an antenna rod extending from the rear.

I'm defining a cable sweep path with catmull-rom points running from the housing front to the barrel rail, binding it to the turret bone, and starting to plan the hazard stripe detailing.

I'm skipping the chevron texture and instead adding yellow strip boxes to each side of the housing's top rim, using a helper function for box parts with position, bone, and color options, then setting up metal paint for the gear components.

Now I'm working out the shield outline coordinates relative to the housing, sizing the box and decal dimensions so the shield fits within the housing width and the decal plane sits slightly above the shield surface without overlapping its edges.
